description: Small symmetric umbrella-inversion sample with equivalent reactant and product minima.
recommended_use: Very small inversion-barrier and endpoint-symmetry test.

reference_values.method: Accepted ammonia inversion barrier used in a one-dimensional inversion model; value attributed there to Rauk and Allen, J. Chem. Phys. 1970
reference_values.note: Not a thermal activation free energy. The sample endpoints are equivalent minima, so the same barrier applies in either direction.

blinder_2018_arxiv.citation: S. M. Blinder, Ammonia Inversion Energy Levels using Operator Algebra, arXiv:1809.08178.

rauk_allen_1970_jcp.citation: A. Rauk and L. C. Allen, Electronic Structure and Inversion Barrier of Ammonia, J. Chem. Phys. 52, 4133-4144 (1970).

curation_note: A true Delta G activation value was not identified in an open source during this pass. The included value is the conventional inversion barrier height.
